# LLMS.txt — SwtFrontend

> SwtFrontend is a free, open-source retro game launcher for Android.
> It turns your phone or tablet into a Nintendo Switch-styled console for playing classic games.

## What it does

- Launches retro games from ROM files stored on your Android device
- Automatically downloads and displays game cover art
- Organizes your library with search, collections, and recently played
- Supports touch controls, Bluetooth gamepads, and TV output
- Provides automatic save states so you never lose progress
- Supports Nintendo DS dual-screen mode on external displays
- Integrates with RetroAchievements for trophies and leaderboards
- Includes a built-in web dashboard for managing your library from a PC
- Supports Android apps alongside games
- 12 accent color themes with dark/light mode

## Supported systems

NES, SNES, Game Boy, Game Boy Color, Game Boy Advance, Sega Genesis, Sega Master System, Nintendo DS, PlayStation, Nintendo 64, and many more through libretro cores.

## Note

SwtFrontend does not include any games. Users must provide their own ROM files.
